name: Lighter Green
lede: Lighter Green is a bright yellow-green recorded in Wikipedia's color lists and the 2010 xkcd survey, built from the comparative lighter rather than the usual light.

sections.title: A comparative build on green
sections.body:
Our Color Graph gives Lighter Green, #75FD63, as modifier grammar: lighter plus the base name [[green]], recorded in Wikipedia's lists and the xkcd survey of 2010 [1]. It is filed directly under green rather than under a narrower base color[1]. The ISCC-NBS system classes the hue as brilliant yellowish green, about 9.4 units from that block's center, one of the wider gaps in this group [1]. Its Munsell notation is 9.8GY 8.9/13.5 and its LCH values are lightness 89, chroma 89, hue 137 degrees[1]. The nearest common library name is [[chartreuse]], 6.2 units away, and the library marks Easter Green as a near neighbor [2].

One near-duplicate, Screamin' Green, sits only 1.3 units off [2]. A fifth, slightly farther neighbor is [[easter-green]], 3.1 ΔE away, duller [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive has a color within CIEDE2000 4 of Lighter Green covering even 1% of its canvas, as photographed [3]. That describes this archive, not painting as a whole: a color this saturated is rare in aged, varnished oil paint regardless of name [3].
